title: User Account Provisioning
text: User accounts must be provisioned through an approved access request process with management approval.

title: Strong Authentication
text: Users must authenticate with unique credentials and strong passwords rotated at least every 90 days.

title: Role-Based Access
text: Access to production systems must be granted using role-based access control aligned to job responsibilities.

title: Security Event Logging
text: Security-relevant events such as authentication failures and privilege changes must be logged.

title: Log Retention
text: Application and infrastructure logs must be retained for at least 365 days.

title: Log Review
text: Security logs must be reviewed on a weekly basis for anomalous activity.

title: Data Retention Policy
text: Customer data must be retained for seven years unless legal or contractual requirements state otherwise.

title: Backup Retention
text: Backups must be retained according to the corporate data retention schedule.

title: Data Disposal
text: Data past its retention period must be securely deleted or anonymized.

title: Incident Response Plan
text: The organization must maintain a documented incident response plan reviewed annually.

title: Incident Reporting
text: Suspected security incidents must be reported to the security team within 24 hours.

title: Post-Incident Review
text: A post-incident review must be conducted after major incidents to identify lessons learned.

title: Encryption At Rest
text: Customer data at rest must be encrypted using industry-standard algorithms such as AES-256.

title: Encryption In Transit
text: All external network communications must be protected using TLS 1.2 or higher.

title: Cryptographic Key Management
text: Cryptographic keys must be stored securely and rotated on at least an annual basis.

title: Vendor Risk Assessment
text: Third-party vendors must undergo a risk assessment prior to onboarding.

title: Vendor Contracts
text: Contracts with vendors must define security responsibilities and data protection requirements.

title: Vendor Monitoring
text: Key vendors must be reviewed at least annually for changes in security posture.

title: Policy Scope
text: This policy applies to all employees contractors and third parties with access to company systems.

title: Training
text: All personnel must complete security awareness training at least annually.

title: Governance
text: Security policies must be reviewed and approved by senior management annually.

title: Privileged Access
text: Administrative access must be limited to authorized personnel and monitored.

title: Session Timeout
text: User sessions must time out after a period of inactivity.

title: Alerting
text: Automated alerts must be generated for high-risk security events.

title: Legal Hold
text: Data subject to legal hold must not be deleted until the hold is released.

title: Tabletop Exercises
text: Incident response tabletop exercises must be performed at least annually.

title: Mobile Encryption
text: Company laptops and mobile devices must use full-disk encryption.

title: Offboarding Vendors
text: Access for terminated vendors must be revoked within 24 hours.

title: Exception Management
text: Security exceptions must be formally documented approved and periodically reviewed.

title: Continuous Improvement
text: The security program must include continuous improvement activities based on risk and lessons learned.
